## Change

Explain the user-visible problem and the change. Link the issue, plan task or component contract.

## Verification

List only checks you actually ran and their observed results. For website changes, include desktop/narrow screenshots and keyboard/theme behavior.

## Safety and rights

- [ ] Planned capabilities remain labeled as planned.
- [ ] Affected documentation and license/asset notices are current.
- [ ] No unrelated edits, private media, secrets or unlicensed assets are included.
- [ ] Commit sign-off is present.

## Limits

State remaining evidence gaps or intentional differences. Remove unused headings; do not leave a fake passing checklist.
